clue.text: Gore visible in explosion to give added weight

indicators.note: the former US vice-president is seen sitting inside the blast, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: an explosion is a blast
Al Gore, the US vice-president, gives his first name

explanation.surface: Bloodshed seen in a bombing gives extra force to a story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gore' looks like blood, but it is the politician Al Gore, supplying AL.
explanation.definitionFit: Ballast is heavy material carried by a ship purely to add weight and steady it.

clue.text: Brave home has 'er housed in a rocky compound

indicators.note: the word 'er is put inside the mineral, so one piece sits in the other

parts.note: mica is a silicate mineral found in rocks
'er, dropped-aitch 'her', is written ER

explanation.surface: A brave lady's home has her installed in a stony enclosure.
explanation.walkthrough: The US anthem calls it 'the home of the brave'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Star-Spangled Banner ends with 'the land of the free and the home of the brave', so America.

clue.text: 27 23 put to death without trial

definitions.meaning: David ..., maker of Blue Velvet, is a film director
mob killing with no legal process

explanation.surface: A film-maker executed by a mob.
explanation.definitionFit: David Lynch directs films, and to lynch is to kill by mob action without trial.

clue.text: 27 23 posted around the Web

indicators.note: the posted word goes around the internet, enclosing it

parts.note: mail posted is sent
the Net is the World Wide Web

explanation.surface: A film-maker put online.
explanation.walkthrough: 'posted around the Web' sounds like sharing online, but it is a container.
explanation.definitionFit: Mack Sennett, creator of the Keystone Kops, was a silent film director.

clue.text: Book not telling you what's what?

definitions.text: Book not telling you what's what?

parts.words: Book not telling you what's what?
parts.note: a reference book that tells you who people are rather than what things are, so it says which person is which, not what is what

explanation.surface: An unhelpful book that leaves its reader none the wiser.
explanation.definitionFit: The well-known biographical reference book lists notable people, telling you who each person is rather than what things are.

clue.text: A king in conduct is a king

indicators.note: the article and the king sit within the word for conduct

parts.note: to hold a meeting is to conduct it
R, for rex, is the king

explanation.surface: A monarch's behaviour marks him out as royal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'conduct' looks like behaviour, but it is the verb, as in holding an event.
explanation.definitionFit: Harold was the name of English kings, Harold II falling at Hastings.

clue.text: Irritable client distraught about closure of trade, underlining price at the start

indicators.note: in a down clue the rest is written beneath the price, so it comes after it

parts.note: SP is the starting price in betting

indicators.note: the jumbled client goes around the final letter of trade
distraught means upset, so the letters of client are disordered
the closure of trade is its last letter

explanation.surface: A customer upset at a shop shutting, with prices emphasised first.
explanation.walkthrough: In betting, the starting price is written SP; 'underlining' works because in a down entry the following letters sit beneath it, and the jumble from 'distraught' plus 'about' gives LENETIC.
explanation.definitionFit: The spleen was thought the seat of bad temper, so splenetic means bad-tempered.

clue.text: Try to know and listen

parts.note: a judge hears a case, that is tries it
ken is Scots for know

explanation.surface: An attempt to understand and pay attention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Try' looks like attempt, but it is the legal sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Hearken is an old verb meaning to listen attentively.

clue.text: It's set up to make daily notes for paid magistrates

indicators.note: in a down clue, set up turns the letters upwards, reading them backwards

parts.note: taken as the letters of its
to pen is to make or compose writing
diaries are daily notes

explanation.surface: Something is arranged so one keeps a journal for the salaried bench.
explanation.definitionFit: Stipendiary magistrates are paid professionals, unlike unpaid lay justices.

clue.text: 27 23's prop

definitions.meaning: David ..., the British maker of Lawrence of Arabia, is a film director
to prop something is to rest or tilt it against a support

explanation.surface: A film-maker's prop.
explanation.definitionFit: David Lean directed films; separately, to lean something is to prop it up against a wall.

clue.text: Note to drop back, discovering flammable substance

parts.note: a natural is a note in music, neither sharp nor flat

indicators.note: back says the word for drop is turned round before joining the note

parts.note: to drop or sink is to sag

explanation.surface: A musical note is to fall back, revealing something that burns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns SAG into GAS; 'to' and 'discovering' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Natural gas, chiefly methane, is a fuel that burns readily, so it is a flammable substance.

clue.text: Fruit that's red in story

indicators.note: the revolutionary sits within the untrue story, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a story can be a lie, a fib
Che Guevara, the Marxist revolutionary, is a classic red

explanation.surface: A fruit that appears in a tale coloured red.
explanation.walkthrough: 'red' reads as a colour, but it is a communist: CHE Guevara.
explanation.definitionFit: The lichee (lychee) is a small Chinese fruit with a rough red skin and white flesh.

clue.text: Roman nation's not finished with runner

indicators.note: the country is left without its final letter, so it stops short

parts.note: Poland is a nation
a ski is a runner that slides over snow

explanation.surface: An ancient Roman's country is incomplete, with an athlete attached.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Roman' suggests an ancient citizen, but it is the first name of the film-maker Roman Polanski.
explanation.definitionFit: Roman Polanski, director of Chinatown, is identified by his first name alone.

clue.text: 27 23 with sailor and soldier in love

parts.note: a tar is an old word for a sailor
a soldier ant is a worker of the colony, so ant stands for soldier
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A film-maker with a sailor and a soldier, both smitten.
explanation.definitionFit: Quentin Tarantino, maker of Pulp Fiction, is a film director.

clue.text: Bond, spy carrying on with English maiden

indicators.note: the spy holds the other pieces inside him

parts.note: a spy is an agent
re means on or about
M is the cricket abbreviation for maiden over

explanation.surface: James Bond the spy carries on with an English girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bond' wants to be 007, but it means a pact; a maiden is an over with no runs.
explanation.definitionFit: A bond is a binding agreement or covenant.

clue.text: 27 23's gem

definitions.meaning: Oliver ..., maker of Platoon, is a film director

explanation.surface: A film-maker's jewel.
explanation.definitionFit: Oliver Stone directs films, and a gem is a precious stone.

clue.text: 27 23, top artist

parts.note: a cap is a top or lid
RA, Royal Academician, is the usual abbreviation for an artist

explanation.surface: A film-maker who is an outstanding painter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top artist' reads as one phrase of praise, but it splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Frank Capra, maker of It's a Wonderful Life, is a film director.

clue.text: Silly, like one square

parts.note: as means like
I is the Roman numeral one
nine is a square number

explanation.surface: Foolish, like a square.
explanation.definitionFit: Asinine, like an ass, means stupid or silly.

clue.text: 27 23 has problem getting raise

parts.note: a hitch is a snag or problem
to cock something, an ear or a hat, is to raise or tilt it

explanation.surface: A film-maker has trouble getting a pay rise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raise' looks like a pay rise, but it is the verb, as in cocking an eyebrow.
explanation.definitionFit: Alfred Hitchcock, maker of Psycho, is a film director.

clue.text: Capital letters 11 and 14, say

indicators.note: say tells us the letter names are spoken

parts.note: the eleventh and fourteenth letters of the alphabet are K and N

explanation.surface: Capital letters numbered eleven and fourteen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital letters' seems to mean upper case, but 'Capital' is the definition. Pronounced, K N sounds like the name.
explanation.definitionFit: Cayenne is the capital city of French Guiana.

clue.text: 27 23 upping record during series

indicators.note: the record sits inside the series

parts.note: a chain is a series

indicators.note: in a down clue upping reads the letters upwards, backwards

parts.note: LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: A film-maker raising a record during a series.
explanation.definitionFit: Charlie Chaplin, maker of Modern Times, was a film director.

clue.text: Old police sergeant's initial lack of activity

parts.note: the Stasi were the East German secret police

indicators.note: the initial of the sergeant is the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: The old police sergeant's first idleness.
explanation.definitionFit: Stasis is a state of stagnation, an absence of movement or activity.

clue.text: See 27
Farmer taking solvers to the country

parts.note: the setter addresses solvers as you, in the old form ye
Oman is a country in Arabia

explanation.surface: A farmer brings crossword fans out to the countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the country' reads as rural land, but it is the nation OMAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A yeoman was a man who farmed his own small estate, so a farmer.

clue.text: Refuse old king over royal posterior

indicators.note: in a down clue the king is written over the other piece

parts.note: Offa was an Anglo-Saxon king of Mercia

indicators.note: the posterior of the word is its last letter

explanation.surface: An old monarch refused, sitting on a royal bottom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' looks like a verb, but it is the noun, rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Offal is the waste parts of a slaughtered animal, so refuse.

clue.text: 27 23, great mind capturing extremes in scene

indicators.note: the genius holds the end letters of the scene within himself

parts.note: Albert Einstein is the byword for a great mind

indicators.note: the extremes of the word scene are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A film-maker, a genius, captures the edges of a shot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'great mind' is a byword that solvers meet often for the physicist; the two end letters of 'scene' slip in after his second letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Sergei Eisenstein, maker of Battleship Potemkin, is a film director.

clue.text: Minister behind princess behind mist for 13, perhaps

indicators.note: the princess comes after the mist, so it follows it in the answer
the minister comes after the princess, so it follows her

parts.note: a film is a thin haze or mist
Di is Princess Diana
a rector is a minister of the church

explanation.surface: A clergyman follows a princess who follows a haze, like 13, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads backwards: each 'behind' places the earlier piece after the later one.
explanation.definitionFit: Roman Polanski, answer 13, is an example of someone who makes films.

clue.text: Most fastidious to put away in home

indicators.note: eating sits within the home, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a nest is a home
to put away food is to eat it

explanation.surface: The tidiest person stows things at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put away' looks like tidying, but it means to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: Neatest is the superlative of neat, tidy and particular, so most fastidious.

clue.text: 27 23 made a splash with Italy

parts.note: to fall in water makes a splash, so fell in
I is the international vehicle code for Italy

explanation.surface: A film-maker took a dip in Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Federico Fellini, maker of La Dolce Vita, is a film director.
